title: The *Rights* Layer
dek: Microsoft's 2.8T training machine runs dark. Meta's new ToS claims the web. The race for the next model's raw material is here.

still_signal: The race is not for the best model; it is for everything that feeds the next one: training efficiency, data rights, feedback loops, physical world data, distribution lock-in.
